title: Bias in Decision-Making for AI’s Ethical Dilemmas: A Comparative Study of Open-source and Closed-source Large Language Models
reasoning: The core focus of this paper is evaluating AI ethical decision-making through moral dilemmas (e.g., the trolley problem and lifeboat dilemma). It systematically benchmarks how LLMs prioritize values when presented with trade-offs involving protected attributes, which specifically include 'Religion' as a core evaluation category.
